auto_fix.title: `human-gate` label is a universal subagent pass on any bead type
auto_fix.fix: Restrict the subagent exemption to legitimate forks: in main(), pass `typ` into the check — `if is_subagent and not (has_label(cmd, SUBAGENT_EXEMPT_LABEL) and typ in PROBE_EXEMPT_TYPES)` — or gate the human-gate exemption on `typ == "decision"`. Add a test: subagent + human-gate + task type -> BLOCK.

auto_fix.title: Shell wrappers (`sh -c`, `$( )`, `env`, `xargs`) bypass the entire guard including the new subagent refusal
auto_fix.fix: When a command contains `-c` with a subsequent argument, tokenize the `-c` value recursively through the same commands() pipeline; additionally scan for `command-substitution` wrappers by checking whether any token equals `br` or ends with `/br` outside a quoted description. At minimum add a loud test case documenting the wrapper bypass so it is a known-tracked gap rather than silent.

auto_fix.title: Subagent refusal gate keys on an agent_id field no deployed harness is documented to send
auto_fix.fix: Drive the field from a real subagent transcript (one driven run where a subagent executes br create) or bind to a documented discriminator; state the exact stdin key each harness must send in the guard header doc and in beads-standards/reference/bead-create-contract.md.

auto_fix.title: Command substitution bypasses the entire guard, including the new subagent refusal and impact axis
auto_fix.fix: Normalize substitution-parentheses in the pre-shlex pass (alongside strip_heredoc_bodies/newlines_to_separators): rewrite `$(` and `` ` `` as `;`-separated boundaries so inner tokens form a real command stream, or drop the bare env-assignment regex skip for tokens containing $( and instead split on the embedded paren. Add guard-test cases: `{agent_id, 'out=$(br create ...)'}` -> BLOCK, and unlabelled `X=$(br create ...)` -> BLOCK.

auto_fix.title: Subagent refusal exemption is label-only: a subagent files any product bead by attaching human-gate
auto_fix.fix: Tighten the exemption in the subagent branch: exempt only when has_label(human-gate) AND bead_type(cmd) == 'decision' (a fork card); every other type from a subagent exits 2 with SUBAGENT_MESSAGE. Update bead-create-contract.md § Subagent creates to state the type condition, and add the evasion fixture to bead-capture-guard.test.py.

auto_fix.title: Impact axis dodged by self-declaring a human/plan/exempt origin first
auto_fix.fix: Decide and enforce an order rule: reject beads carrying multiple `origin:` labels outright ( MESSAGE: one origin per bead, per the docstring claim), or if human-bead exemption must hold, validate every origin value with a closed set of EXEMPT origins and flag mixed human+automated origins (e.g. origin:manual,origin:ac-implement) as IMPACT_REQUIRED. Reuse the ORIGIN regex inside origin_skill() so both checks share one parser.

auto_fix.title: Subagent refusal keyed on a per-harness stdin field that is not guaranteed everywhere
auto_fix.fix: Verify which projections send agent_id (Claude Code does; Codex/Pi/Droid projections need confirming) and fall back to an ambient signal (e.g. an env var like AC_SUBAGENT=1 stamped by the harness) where the field is absent; add a per-harness assertion test analogous to the HookSync public guard so an inert refusal is caught on deploy rather than assumed.

auto_fix.title: New impact-axis checks re-parse the label list multiple times per br create
auto_fix.fix: In the main() loop, compute labels = all_labels(cmd) once per bead-create command segment and derive has_origin, has_readiness, has_probe, origin_skill, valid_impact, and the human-gate/subagent checks from that single list (or have those helpers accept the precomputed list). Removes 4 redundant scans and makes adding the next contract axis free.

auto_fix.title: Impact-axis exemption implemented as a closed origin allowlist - unlisted automated origins silently bypass
auto_fix.fix: Invert the predicate: require valid_impact for ANY origin:* EXCEPT explicit exemptions {manual, ac-human, ac-beadify, ac-backlog}; refuse unknown origin:* values not in either list (mirrors IMPACT_CLASSES closed-set posture). Add test cases for ac-polish/ac-qa creates.

auto_fix.title: Impact axis covers only 7 of the sanctioned automated origins — ac-qa, ac-land, dream, reflect file beads with no impact label
auto_fix.fix: Decide the universe: either add origin:ac-qa, origin:ac-land (and origin:dream/origin:reflect) to IMPACT_REQUIRED_ORIGINS and the contract row, or document in bead-create-contract.md why those origins are impact-exempt. Currently the exemption is implicit and unrecorded.

auto_fix.title: origin:unknown escapes the impact axis for any automated filer
auto_fix.fix: Sanctioned options: (a) treat origin:unknown as impact-REQUIRED (unattributable origin is exactly when the damage class is most needed for triage); or (b) make bead-create-contract.md explicitly state that origin:unknown beads are impact-exempt and record why. Today the exemption is an accident of tuple membership, not a decision.
